recipe_title: Spiced Tilapia and Orange Quinoa Bowls

details.title_candidate: Spiced Tilapia and Orange Quinoa Bowls

details.summary: This is an exceptionally well-crafted recipe that perfectly fits the book's dietary framework, time constraints, and culinary standards. The use of a ready-to-eat quinoa pouch combined with a quick fish sear delivers a vibrant, structurally sound meal with superb flavor balance.

dimensions.feedback: The combination of earthy cumin and smoked paprika on the fish pairs beautifully with the sweet navel orange, peppery arugula, and creamy avocado. Excellent balance of acid, fat, and flavor.
All ingredients are correctly accounted for in the instructions, with the divided olive oil clearly allocated between the pan and the dressing.
Instructions are thorough and helpful. They feature a cook time range (3 to 4 minutes per side), a check time at 6 minutes, and clear visual doneness cues (golden crust, flakes easily).
Perfectly aligns with the Mediterranean-American style, utilizing olive oil, fresh citrus, arugula, and whole grains with warm spices.
Pan-searing is the ideal quick-cooking method for thin tilapia fillets. Utilizing a microwaveable quinoa pouch is a highly suitable and efficient shortcut.
The nutritional values are well-calculated and accurately reflect the ingredients used, correctly capturing the macros from the lean tilapia, quinoa, avocado, and olive oil.
Title and intro accurately describe the dish and highlight its key ingredients without employing any banned health claims, detox language, or diet framing.
The recipe is highly appetizing and vibrant. It offers a wonderful mix of textures, colors, and temperatures that will make for a very satisfying meal.
Genuinely addresses both insulin resistance and liver health by providing lean protein, high-quality complex carbohydrates, heart-healthy unsaturated fats, and ample fresh vegetables.
Passes flawlessly. Zero added sugar; all sweetness comes naturally from the whole navel orange. The carbohydrate load is a high-quality 42.7g, sitting perfectly in the target 25-45g window.
Fits the 'Soups & Salads' light main tier perfectly. The macros align seamlessly with the goals (under 440 calories, adequate protein, excellent fiber, and appropriate sodium).

Easily completed in under 30 minutes from a cold start. The use of a ready-to-eat quinoa pouch is a smart, permitted shortcut that keeps active prep minimal. All ingredients are standard supermarket items.
